Area.evidence_source: A total of 35 men, aged 20 to 68 years (M = 44 years old), with a past history of suicidality participated in the study. Participants had previously experienced suicidal thoughts (n = 35), planned their suicide (n = 27), and/or attempted suicide (n = 17). Participants had received professional help for their suicidality (n = 24) and been formally diagnosed with mental illness[es] (n = 22) including depression (n = 15), bipolar disorder (n = 7), personality disorders (n = 6), and anxiety (n = 5).
